description:
Because:

- Fetching only the best locale and en dropped same-language siblings, so es-MX, pt-BR and zh-CN users saw English strings.

This commit:

- Fetches the full negotiated locale list in AppLocalizationProvider.
- Drops en-GB and en-CA unless one is the best locale.
- Extends the fetch list table and adds an es-MX fallback render test.

Closes FXA-14879
